citations.quote: Repos are short-term contracts that are used to lend money on the security of usually high-grade collateral, to finance the purchase of bonds, and to borrow bonds to be sold short
So while repo investors are willing to accept general collateral, reverses require the delivery of a particular bond

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A repurchase agreement is a short-term collateralised loan: the borrower sells the bond and agrees to repurchase it at a slightly higher price, paying the repo rate. The market clears at a general-collateral (GC) rate for any acceptable Treasury and a lower special rate for bonds in unusually high demand; specialness benefits the long holder via funding subsidy and is bounded by the fails-charge.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Repurchase Agreements and Specials
